title: Region Pin Orchestration and Evidence Telemetry for Hosted API
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need a deterministic way to bind Hosted API requests to specific geographies and to produce machine-readable audit artifacts proving that requests were served and stored according to the chosen residency and retention profiles. Current pin controls are fragmented (per-endpoint flags + ad-hoc region fallbacks) and there is no standardized evidence export for audits.

Goal: Deliver a single orchestrated region-pin configuration model for Hosted API that supports: (1) declarative pin rules (tenant/route/endpoint), (2) retention profile ties to pinned regions, (3) runtime telemetry that records routing decisions and storage locations, and (4) an automated evidence export that packages routing traces, retention settings, and attestations for compliance reviewers.

Scope:
- Add an API contract for declarative region pins and pin precedence rules.
- Console UX: a Pin Config editor and a per-tenant Pin Audit timeline.
- Backend: policy engine to evaluate pins and emit telemetry events (routing decision, fallback reason, final region).
- Evidence pipeline: compose signed proof bundles (JSON + metadata + signed manifest) for a selectable time window.
- Tests: synthetic verification harness that replays traffic and validates proof bundles.

Out of scope: Fine-grained per-token residency, on-prem installation changes (handled in Private roadmap), and billing integration for region-specific pricing (separate project).

Deliverables: API spec, console flows, backend policy + telemetry, evidence-export worker, end-to-end test suite, PRD and runbook for support escalations.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST/GET/PUT endpoints to create/update/delete declarative pin manifests with validation and versioning.
Console: Pin editor that allows selecting region sets, precedence, and retention profiles; changes are audit-logged.
Runtime: Every Hosted API request annotated with a telemetry packet containing evaluated pin, resolved region, and fallback reason when applicable.

Evidence export: Ability for tenant admins and compliance teams to request time-bounded proof bundles that include routing traces, retention metadata, and a signed manifest; export generation completes within SLA (<= 15 minutes for 30 days of data).
Security: Evidence bundles include verifiable signatures and do not contain plaintext customer secrets; KMS integration for signing is validated.
Regression: E2E test harness can simulate cross-region failures and assert evidence contains correct fallback rationale.
